claim: Eating Barley Porridge raises Community as well as Food, although the resource record stores only Food units.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report, 25 October 2026. The game’s Porridge Cookhouse description says the dish raises Nutrition and Community. The Barley Porridge ResourceConfig stores FoodUnits 2 and CommunityUnits 0.

notes: The second effect is not in the resource’s stored units, so it must come from somewhere the extraction did not decode: the ResourceVariationDatabase, or the way dishes are consumed at the cookhouse. Stew, Fondue and Manchamanteles have the same pattern; carried gear and social-spot buildings have no stored units at all. The Needs page now shows description-stated effects alongside stored units.
